meta.notes: Winter's Jest update added Dayan, Obambo, and Gallu

evidenceTypes.name: EMF Level 5
evidenceTypes.description: EMF reader spikes to level 5 near ghost interactions or locations

evidenceTypes.name: Spirit Box
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost verbally responds to questions when spoken to in darkness

evidenceTypes.name: Ultraviolet
evidenceTypes.description: Fingerprints or footprints visible under UV light on doors, windows, or floors

evidenceTypes.name: Ghost Writing
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost writes a message in a placed Ghost Writing Book

evidenceTypes.name: Ghost Orb
evidenceTypes.description: Small floating orbs visible only through night-vision video camera feed

evidenceTypes.name: D.O.T.S Projector
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost silhouette briefly appears crawling through the laser grid

ghosts.name: Spirit
ghosts.strength: None — the Spirit is the most common ghost type
ghosts.weakness: Smudge sticks are extra effective, preventing hunts for 180 seconds instead of 90

uniqueBehaviors.description: Smudge sticks prevent hunting for 180 seconds (double the normal 90 seconds)
No abnormal speed or interaction patterns — baseline ghost behavior

identifyingClues: Process of elimination — Spirit is confirmed when all other possibilities are ruled out
If smudging stops hunts for an unusually long time, it is likely a Spirit

ghosts.name: Wraith
ghosts.strength: Does not leave UV footprints in salt — nearly impossible to track physically
ghosts.weakness: Stepping near salt generates only EMF 2 instead of the normal EMF 3, revealing its presence

uniqueBehaviors.description: Does NOT step in salt — will not leave footprints when passing through a salt pile
Generates EMF 2 (not 3) at salt pile locations when it passes through them
Can teleport directly to a random player's location, generating EMF 2 at the destination

identifyingClues: Salt near ghost room shows no footprints despite ghost activity
Salt pile shows EMF 2 reading but no UV footprints
Ghost appears in unexpected locations far from its room without walking

ghosts.name: Phantom
ghosts.strength: Causes greater sanity loss when players look at it during a ghost event
ghosts.weakness: Taking a photo of the Phantom during an event causes it to temporarily disappear (become invisible)

uniqueBehaviors.description: Taking a photo of the Phantom during a ghost event causes it to vanish — photo is still credited
Slows to 0.5× its normal speed when a player looks directly at it during a hunt
Drains player sanity at a faster rate when the player is looking at it
Blinks in and out of visibility more frequently than other ghosts during hunts

identifyingClues: Ghost disappears when photographed during an event
Ghost slows noticeably when player makes eye contact during a hunt
Unusually fast sanity drain when watching ghost events

ghosts.name: Poltergeist
ghosts.strength: Can throw multiple objects simultaneously in a wide radius
ghosts.weakness: Has reduced power in empty rooms with no throwable objects

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can throw multiple objects at once in a radius around itself
Throws objects with significantly more force and frequency than any other ghost
Each thrown object drains 2% sanity from nearby players

identifyingClues: Multiple objects flying across the room simultaneously
Objects thrown great distances with unusual force
Very high interaction count with environment objects

ghosts.name: Banshee
ghosts.strength: Focuses exclusively on its chosen target and ignores other players during hunts
ghosts.weakness: Crucifix protection radius is 5 meters (not 3m) for its target — easier to protect the target

uniqueBehaviors.description: Selects one player as its 'target' at the start — will hunt this player even if others have lower sanity
Produces a unique wailing/screeching sound detectable on the Parabolic Microphone
Crucifix protection radius is doubled to 5m for its designated target
Hunt behavior and roaming patterns center around its target player, not just the ghost room

identifyingClues: Unique wail/screech sound heard on Parabolic Microphone
During hunts, ghost ignores low-sanity players and chases a specific individual
Ghost consistently roams toward one particular player's location

ghosts.name: Jinn
ghosts.strength: Moves at increased speed (2.5 m/s) when its target is far away and the fuse box is on
ghosts.weakness: Turning off the fuse box prevents the Jinn from using its speed ability

uniqueBehaviors.description: Travels at 2.5 m/s when its target is 3+ meters away AND the fuse box is powered on
Speed ability is completely disabled when the fuse box is turned off
Can use a territory ability to instantly drain 25% sanity from all players in its area
Will not turn off the fuse box itself

identifyingClues: Moves extremely fast when fuse box is on but slows dramatically when it's turned off
Sudden mass sanity loss across all players simultaneously
Fuse box stays powered on despite ghost activity

ghosts.name: Mare
ghosts.strength: Hunts at 60% sanity in darkness — far earlier than most ghosts
ghosts.weakness: Has a lower 40% hunt threshold if lights are on in its room — keeping lights on is protective

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunts at 60% average sanity when its room is dark, but only 40% when lights are on
Actively tries to turn off lights — has a higher chance of turning lights off during events
Cannot turn lights ON — only turns them off

identifyingClues: Lights go off frequently and unexpectedly
Ghost never turns lights back on after turning them off
Early hunts in dark rooms before sanity has dropped very low

ghosts.name: Revenant
ghosts.strength: Moves at 3 m/s when it detects a player — one of the fastest hunting ghosts
ghosts.weakness: Travels at only 1 m/s when no player is detected — very slow when no one is found

uniqueBehaviors.description: Extremely slow (1 m/s) when no player is detected or visible
Surges to 3 m/s instantly when it detects or sees a player — one of the fastest ghosts
Speed change is dramatic and sudden — the contrast between slow/fast is highly noticeable

identifyingClues: Ghost moves extremely slowly while wandering, then instantly sprints when it spots someone
Ghost feels 'lazy' until a player is detected, then becomes very dangerous
During hunts, standing very still can keep the ghost slow as it searches

ghosts.name: Shade
ghosts.strength: Extremely difficult to get evidence from — will not interact when players are nearby
ghosts.weakness: Will not initiate a hunt if any player is in the same room as it

uniqueBehaviors.description: Will not perform interactions or events when a player is in the same room
Cannot initiate a hunt if any player is in its current room
Very low hunt sanity threshold of 35% — won't hunt until sanity is very low
Can manifest as a shadow figure instead of a full ghost appearance during events

identifyingClues: Very little activity when investigators are present in the ghost room
Evidence appears only when no one is watching or inside the room
Surprisingly safe investigation — rarely hunts even at low sanity
Ghost room activity increases when all players leave

ghosts.name: Demon
ghosts.strength: Can initiate a hunt at ANY sanity level, including 100%
ghosts.weakness: Successful crucifix use against it counts as two uses — and crucifix has a 5m range

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can hunt at any sanity level — even at 100% team sanity
Shortest cooldown between hunts — 20 seconds vs. the normal 25 seconds
Crucifix effective range is doubled to 5 meters instead of 3 meters
Ouija Board questions do not drain sanity when asked to a Demon

identifyingClues: Hunts extremely early in the investigation before sanity has dropped
Multiple back-to-back hunts with very short cooldowns
Hunts happening despite full or near-full team sanity

ghosts.name: Yurei
ghosts.strength: Applies heavy sanity drain to players in the same room during ghost events
ghosts.weakness: Smudging within its room temporarily traps it there — it cannot wander for 90 seconds

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can fully slam a door shut during ghost events (doors close completely, not partially)
Smudging within its room traps it in that room for 90 seconds — it cannot roam
Applies significant sanity drain to players who are in the same room during its ghost event

identifyingClues: Doors slamming fully shut rather than just swinging
Unusual sanity drain when standing in the ghost room during events
After smudging, ghost stays in one room and doesn't roam to other areas

ghosts.name: Oni
ghosts.strength: More active and throws objects more forcefully when players are present
ghosts.weakness: Increased activity makes it easier to find and gather evidence

uniqueBehaviors.description: Activity level increases when players are in the same room — more interactions, more events
CANNOT produce the air ball / ghost mist ghost event — if you never see mist, suspect Oni
Throws objects harder and with greater frequency than other ghosts
Appears in full physical form more often — less likely to appear as a shadow

identifyingClues: Very high activity when players are present in the ghost room
Never produces the floating ball of ghost mist (air ball) event
Evidence is easy to gather because ghost is very interactive

ghosts.name: Yokai
ghosts.strength: Speaking near it triggers hunts at 80% sanity — far above the normal 50%
ghosts.weakness: During hunts, can only detect players within 2.5 meters — very short detection range
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: 80% when players are talking near it

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt threshold jumps to 80% sanity when players talk near it — talking is dangerous
During hunts, can only detect players within 2.5 meters (vs. normal ~10 meters)
Talking near the ghost increases its activity and event frequency

identifyingClues: Hunts very early when players are talking inside or near the ghost room
During a hunt, ghost seems unable to find players who are moderately far away
Activity spikes noticeably when players speak aloud

ghosts.name: Hantu
ghosts.strength: Moves faster in cold rooms — in freezing temperatures it can reach 2.7 m/s
ghosts.weakness: Moves very slowly in warm rooms — turning the fuse box off limits its speed

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt speed directly correlates with room temperature — faster in cold, slower in warm rooms
Cannot turn the fuse box on — fuse box stays off if the Hantu turns it off
In freezing temperature rooms, can reach up to 2.7 m/s — dangerous in cold ghost rooms
Emits a visible fog breath cloud more frequently than other ghosts

identifyingClues: Ghost moves dramatically faster in cold rooms than in warm corridors
Speed fluctuates visibly as ghost transitions between rooms of different temperatures
Fuse box does not turn back on after ghost activity

ghosts.name: Goryo
ghosts.strength: DOTS Projector evidence only visible through a video camera — not visible to the naked eye
ghosts.weakness: Rarely strays from its ghost room — very limited roaming range

uniqueBehaviors.description: DOTS silhouette is ONLY visible through a video camera feed — never with the naked eye
Only produces DOTS evidence when no players are in the same room as the projector
Has a very strong room preference — rarely moves to other rooms when not hunting

identifyingClues: DOTS projector placed in ghost room shows no activity while players watch, but camera feed shows silhouette
Ghost almost never leaves its designated room between hunts
Must review camera footage remotely to confirm DOTS evidence

ghosts.name: Myling
ghosts.strength: Very quiet during hunts — ghost footsteps and equipment interference have shorter range
ghosts.weakness: Produces very frequent paranormal sounds, making it easy to locate with the Parabolic Microphone

uniqueBehaviors.description: Footstep sounds and equipment interference are only audible within a very short range during hunts
Electronic interference (flashlight flickering) also has a shorter range — less warning when hunting
Produces paranormal sounds very frequently — Parabolic Microphone constantly picks up activity

identifyingClues: Equipment stops flickering and sounds cut out much closer to the ghost than expected during a hunt
Ghost sneaks up without the usual audio warnings
Parabolic Microphone detects constant paranormal sounds even when ghost is inactive

ghosts.name: Onryo
ghosts.strength: Extinguishing a flame near it can trigger an immediate hunt attempt
ghosts.weakness: Lit flames act like a crucifix — the ghost will not hunt while a flame is present nearby

uniqueBehaviors.description: Lit candles, lighters, and flames prevent it from initiating a hunt within 4 meters — like a crucifix
Each time a flame is extinguished near it, there is an extra chance it will immediately try to hunt
Higher base hunt threshold of 60% sanity — hunts earlier than most ghosts
Will prioritize blowing out candles as a ghost interaction

identifyingClues: Hunts start suspiciously early, especially when candles get blown out
Keeping candles lit near the ghost room prevents hunts even at low sanity
Ghost seems drawn to candles and frequently extinguishes them

ghosts.name: The Twins
ghosts.strength: Can interact with the environment from two separate locations simultaneously
ghosts.weakness: Either twin can start a hunt — one hunts at 1.9× speed, the other at 0.75× speed

uniqueBehaviors.description: Interacts with objects in two places almost simultaneously — one within 3m, one within 16m of ghost room
Either 'twin' can initiate a hunt — hunt can start from the main ghost location or the distant interaction point
One twin moves at 1.9 m/s during hunts, the other at 1.5 m/s — inconsistent hunt speed

identifyingClues: Objects interacting in two completely separate rooms nearly simultaneously
Hunts appear to start from a location the ghost was never seen near
Inconsistent ghost hunt speed between hunts

ghosts.name: Raiju
ghosts.strength: Speeds up significantly near active electronic equipment during hunts
ghosts.weakness: Disrupts electronics from a farther range, making it easier to detect its location

uniqueBehaviors.description: Moves faster near active electronics (cameras, phones, equipment) during hunts — up to 2.5 m/s
Disrupts electronic equipment from 15 meters away (vs. 10 meters for normal ghosts)
Sanity drain rate is not abnormal — normal passive drain

identifyingClues: Ghost moves notably faster near deployed equipment during a hunt
Equipment begins flickering from farther distances than expected
Turning off or putting away active electronics slows the ghost during a hunt

ghosts.name: Obake
ghosts.strength: Can leave unique 6-finger UV handprints — and has a chance to leave no fingerprints at all
ghosts.weakness: Has a small chance to reveal its true form briefly during hunts by shape-shifting

uniqueBehaviors.description: Has a 1-in-6 chance to leave 6-fingered handprints (instead of normal 5 fingers) under UV
Has a small chance to leave NO fingerprints at all, even though UV is its evidence type
Can change its ghost model (shape-shift) during hunts — may appear as a different ghost type
Fingerprints fade faster than normal — shorter UV evidence window

identifyingClues: 6-fingered handprint found under UV light
Ghost changes its appearance during a single hunt
UV fingerprints disappear noticeably faster than expected

ghosts.name: The Mimic
ghosts.strength: Mimics the behavior, abilities, and evidence of other ghost types — extremely difficult to identify
ghosts.weakness: Always produces Ghost Orbs as a fake 4th piece of evidence, revealing its deceptive nature

uniqueBehaviors.description: Periodically changes which ghost type it mimics, copying that ghost's behavior and ghost-specific traits
ALWAYS shows Ghost Orb evidence even though it is NOT one of its three real evidence types
Mimicry includes hunt speed, sanity thresholds, and special interactions of the ghost being copied

identifyingClues: Ghost Orb is present alongside Spirit Box, UV, and Freezing — 4 evidence pieces confirms Mimic
Ghost behavior seems to contradict its evidence or changes behavior between hunts
Behaviors from multiple different ghost types observed in a single investigation

ghosts.name: Moroi
ghosts.strength: Curses players who hear it through Spirit Box, causing doubled sanity drain rate
ghosts.weakness: Smudge sticks disorient it for 12 seconds during a hunt (double the normal 6 seconds)

uniqueBehaviors.description: Players who hear the Moroi respond through Spirit Box, Parabolic Mic, or Sound Recorder become cursed — sanity drains twice as fast
Hunt speed increases as team average sanity decreases — up to 3.7 m/s at very low sanity (fastest in the game)
Smudge sticks blind it for 12 seconds instead of the normal 6 seconds

identifyingClues: Team sanity drops very rapidly after using the Spirit Box
Ghost becomes progressively faster as investigation continues and sanity falls
Smudge sticks seem to blind the ghost for longer than usual

ghosts.name: Deogen
ghosts.strength: Always knows the exact location of all players — hiding is completely useless
ghosts.weakness: Slows to 0.4 m/s when very close to a player — the slowest ghost at close range

uniqueBehaviors.description: Has permanent line-of-sight to all players during hunts — hiding in lockers or behind obstacles does not work
Moves at 3 m/s when far from a player but drops to 0.4 m/s when within 2.5 meters of one
Produces a unique slow, heavy breathing / bull-like sound through the Spirit Box
Lower hunt sanity threshold of 40%

identifyingClues: Unique breathing/snorting sound heard through Spirit Box (distinct from normal voice responses)
Ghost finds hidden players easily — hides do not work
Ghost charges quickly from far away but slows dramatically when it gets close — circling behavior

ghosts.name: Thaye
ghosts.strength: Starts very powerful — high hunt threshold and fast speed when young
ghosts.weakness: Ages over time, becoming slower and less likely to hunt as the investigation progresses
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: Starts at 75% when young, decreases to 15% at maximum age

uniqueBehaviors.description: 'Ages' progressively — starts fast and active (75% hunt threshold), ends slow and passive (15% threshold)
Aging accelerates when players are present in the ghost room — spending time near it speeds up its aging
Activity, hunt speed, and hunt frequency all decrease as the Thaye ages
Can be prompted to age via Ouija Board interaction

identifyingClues: Investigation starts with an extremely aggressive ghost that rapidly calms down over time
Ghost seems less interested in hunting as investigation progresses past the first few minutes
Activity level drops noticeably over the course of the investigation

ghosts.name: Obambo
ghosts.strength: Hunts earlier and moves faster when in its aggressive state
ghosts.weakness: Easier to track and hunts later when in its calm state
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: Higher threshold (~60%) when aggressive, lower (~40%) when calm

uniqueBehaviors.description: Alternates between 'calm' and 'aggressive' states approximately every 2 minutes
When aggressive: hunts at higher sanity threshold and moves faster during hunts
When calm: lower hunt threshold, slower movement, and easier to track with equipment
State transitions are unpredictable — ghost mood switches without warning

identifyingClues: Hunt behavior is wildly inconsistent — sometimes hunts early, sometimes very late
Ghost activity visibly cycles between aggressive and quiet phases roughly every 2 minutes
Speed during hunts varies significantly between encounters

ghosts.name: Gallu
ghosts.strength: Using protective equipment (crucifix, incense) causes it to enter an enraged state
ghosts.weakness: After being enraged, it exhausts itself and enters a weakened state where protection is more effective

uniqueBehaviors.description: Has three states: normal, enraged, and weakened — transitions triggered by use of protective equipment
When enraged: moves faster and protective equipment (crucifix, incense) is weakened / less effective
After being enraged, exhaustion causes it to enter a weakened state — protective gear becomes more effective
Using a crucifix or incense against it triggers the enraged state transition

identifyingClues: Using a crucifix or incense makes the ghost visibly angrier and faster rather than calming it
Ghost seems to hunt through or despite protective equipment in a cyclic pattern
After an aggressive phase triggered by protection use, the ghost becomes noticeably weakened

ghosts.name: Dayan
ghosts.strength: Speeds up dramatically when players move within 10 meters of it during a hunt
ghosts.weakness: Slows down significantly when players within 10 meters stand completely still

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt speed increases dramatically when any player within 10 meters is moving
Hunt speed decreases significantly when all nearby players (within 10m) stand completely still
Speed change is near-instantaneous — running while it hunts nearby will make it almost double in speed
Outside of hunts, it gains power from player movement nearby and loses power when players are still

identifyingClues: Ghost accelerates rapidly the moment players start running during a hunt
Standing completely still causes the ghost to slow or stall noticeably
Movement near ghost room during setup causes increased activity
